contextErrorDiagnosis.observed: ExternalPluginContextLoader emitted {"result":[{"type":"error","error":{}}]} for every fixture; contextErrorCount was 2 on 17 cases and 3 on 6 cases.
contextErrorDiagnosis.source: Pinned SDK DefaultContextModule installs ExternalPluginContextLoader as a default Ethereum loader. Its HttpExternalPluginDataSource requests https://crypto-assets-service.api.ledger.com/v1/dapps; an Either Left is converted by ExternalPluginContextLoader into an ERROR context. BuildBaseContexts counts ERROR contexts and removes them before providing contexts.
contextErrorDiagnosis.impact: CalldataContextLoader supplied the injected ERC-7730 descriptor contexts; all cases still used clearSigningType eip7730, usedFallback false, and signed. The error is optional external-plugin context enrichment, not proof of a production plugin or descriptor failure.

externalPluginHTTPProbe.interpretation: Matches the SDK ExternalPluginContextLoader error; descriptor CAL injection is independent and still provided all contexts.
